run_train_keyboard: run the train_keyboard script to pretrain an option keyboard agent for 20000 episodes
run_train_keyboard_with_weights: run train_keyboard with specific policy weights like 1,2,3 to train multiple keyboard policies
run_train_keyboard_export: run train_keyboard with an export path to save trained keyboard checkpoints to disk
refactor_main_policy_weights: refactor the main function to support additional policy weight configurations beyond the five predefined ones
review_create_and_train_keyboard: review the keyboard_utils create_and_train_keyboard function to understand agent initialization and training parameters
